# Draft and approved access policy

## Documents

- root: [Draft and approved access policy](policy-en.md)

## Rules

Approved policy: members can read internal documents. Guests cannot read internal documents. Public documents can be read by everyone.

Proposed change: invited guests could read selected internal documents for seven days. This proposal is not approved and must not be treated as current access.
